summary: Apply semantic A4-prefill/A16-decode selection to B12X dense NVFP4 layers
models: NVFP4 models using B12X dense linear kernels
compatibility: B12X_W4A16_A4_PREFILL=1 now covers dense NVFP4 layers in auto activation mode, including shared experts. Explicit dense precision overrides and W4A16 checkpoint precision are preserved. Restart workers to apply the policy.
details: Calibrated prefill rows use A4 independently of token count; decode, verification, draft, profiling, and CUDA graph execution retain A16.
A4 and A16 plans share one packed weight and reuse a single workspace across semantic token spans.
Missing or invalid A4 calibration and unsupported A4 input widths retain A16. Encoder-decoder models and token redistribution configurations without a matching row-order contract reject hybrid mode.
